verdict.rationale: The docs name specific webhook events across the agentic commerce flows, so the core of subscribing to events is clearly delivered. These include v2.commerce.product_catalog.imports succeeded/succeeded_with_errors/failed for catalog indexing, checkout.session.completed per agent order, delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed for embedded checkout, and per-transition SPT events such as shared_payment.issued_token.used. Missing for 10: documentation in the pack of how endpoints are registered and subscribed, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
